title: When the customer pays for itself the email list is today's
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, that bills itself, with two contacts whose email addresses you can read: contact A1, marked Billing, and contact A2.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, with a contact of its own, so another customer's contacts exist that must not be listed.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, invoiced, that bills itself.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the invoice's email (send) window on the Finance tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The send window lists contact A1 and contact A2, as it does today.
  • The contact ticked is the one ShopView ticks for customer A today.
  • No contact of customer B is listed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12311 (Story 9, Invoice email to the Bill To)

  • S9-N1: “When the customer pays for itself, the list and the pre-ticked contact are exactly today's.”
